# Novelty and feasibility report

Novelty delta vs the three nearest works: (1) vs 2610.10023 — we add temporal labels and
spiking state, not static accuracy; (2) vs 2604.04033 — we do not re-ask "does topology win",
we ask "which spiking mechanism makes the temporal label learnable and does stacking compose";
(3) vs 2609.01330 — we train a visual readout on a behavioural task, not simulate neural
orientation maps. Higher-order nulls and real optical-flow data remain open later axes.

Known risks (from 9 independent reviews, scores 4.3–6.3): venue mismatch, diagnostic framing,
and the null-model boundary being anticipated. These are carried as G8/P12 gates and as an
explicit honesty constraint in guidance.md §6; they are not resolved by assertion.

Feasibility: all data directly public, local + 4090 compute available and authorised,
prototype self-test passed, 5-seed statistical protocol and kill criteria preregistered.
